  JOINT MEETING WITH PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor and Chair have called a special joint meeting of the City Council
and Park & Activities Commission for the purpose of a joint meeting of the Pepper Tree Foundation Board and
the Pepper Tree Foundation Advisory Board, to be called to order via teleconference at 6:00 p.m. on Tuesday,
October 13, 2020. The agenda for the special meeting with the items of business to be transacted or discussed is
set forth below.
Posted by the office of the City Clerk on Thursday, October 1, 2020.

NOTE:  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION INFORMATION
  Pursuant to the Governor's Executive Order N-29-20, City Council Members will be participating via
  teleconference.
  - City Council meeting videos are recorded and live-streamed on the City’s website at www.rhe.city and
  available for viewing thereafter, and televised on Cox 33 and Frontier FiOS 38 on Wednesday and Friday
  following the meeting.
  - Members of the public may listen to the meeting live by calling: (1-669-900-6833) from any phone,
  Meeting ID: 876 4557 8358 Meeting Password: 066081. (Please note you will not have the ability to
  speak using the call-in option from a phone line.)
  - Public correspondence may be emailed to the City Clerk at laurenp@rollinghillsestatesca.gov. Emails
  received before 5:00 p.m. the night of the Council meeting will be forwarded to the City Council for their
  consideration and included as part of the record.
  - Members of the public may comment online using eComment on the “Meeting Agendas, Minutes &
  Videos” page of the City’s website (www.rhe.city/MeetingAgendas). Once the agenda is published, there
  will be an “eComment” button next to the linked agenda under "Upcoming Events". Follow this link to
  the City’s SpeakUp page. After you register, you may comment on any item on that particular agenda.
  These comments can be seen by the public, will be considered by the Council and become part of the
  record.
  - Members of the public who wish to speak during this meeting may join the Zoom meeting by accessing the
  Zoom app from a computer (downloaded at Zoom.com) or tablet or phone (downloaded in the App Store),
  by entering the following credentials: Meeting ID: 876 4557 8358, Meeting Password: 066081. Members
  of the public who join the Zoom meeting will not have video, and may request to speak using the following
  process: After joining the Zoom meeting, if you wish to speak, please select the "raise hand" option at the
  lower portion of your screen. The City Clerk will send you a chat message to identify which item on the
  agenda you would like to speak on and will unmute your mic at the appropriate time.
  -Agenda reports and other disclosable public records relating to each Open Session agenda item are
  available on the City's website under Meeting Agendas, Minutes & Videos at www.rhe.city.

MINUTES
 SPECIAL JOINT CITY COUNCIL AND PARK & ACTIVITIES COMMISSION MEETING
  OCTOBER 13, 2020

1.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER

A Special Joint meeting of the City Council and the Park & Activities Commission of the City
of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order by MAYOR SCHMITZ at 6:03 p.m. via
teleconference, pursuant to the Governor’s Executive Order N-29-20.

2.  SALUTE TO THE FLAG

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None

P&A Commissioners Present:  Bain, Ciarolla, McCormick, Persichina, Romanelli, Pope

P&A Commissioners Absent:  Retz

City Staff Present:  City Manager Greg Grammer
  City Attorney Don Davis
  Assistant City Manager Alexa Davis
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  City Clerk Lauren Pettit
  Community Services Supervisor Cynthia Morquecho

4.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

NONE.

5.  NEW BUSINESS

  MAYOR PRO TEM ZUCKERMAN moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER
  ZERUNYAN,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL ADJOURN TO THE PEPPER TREE
  FOUNDATION BOARD MEETING.

  Hearing no objection, MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered.

*ADJOURNMENT TO PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD MEETING OF THE
PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD AND THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION
ADVISORY BOARD

A.  AMENDMENTS TO THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BYLAWS

City Manager Grammer provided an introduction to the Pepper Tree Foundation bylaws
discussion, followed by a staff report provided by General Counsel Davis (as per the agenda
material).

  DIRECTOR HUFF moved to separate the consideration of the entire bylaws from
  Section 1.02 for independent discussion and consideration at a later time.

  DIRECTOR ZUCKERMAN amended DIRECTOR HUFF’s motion to separate the
  discussion and consideration of Section 1.02, and consider the remainder of the
  bylaws first. DIRECTOR HUFF seconded this motion.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
OCTOBER 13, 2020
 DIRECTOR HUFF commented on Section 4.01 and the removal of the number of Advisory
Board Members. Discussion ensued regarding the number of Advisory Board Members and
quorum requirements.

Public comment was received by Bridget Carman who expressed concerns regarding Section
1.02 Specific Purposes of the proposed bylaw amendments.

DIRECTOR ZUCKERMAN suggested this item be continued for further discussion.

CHAIR SCHMITZ surveyed the Advisory Board for any additional comments.

ADVISORY BOARD MEMBER BAIN expressed concern about Section 1.02, and that the Park
& Activities Commission did not first have an independent discussion regarding these bylaws.

DIRECTOR ZERUNYAN noted this is not an urgent item and echoed the sentiments to delay
this item for a future discussion after the Park & Activities Commission have deliberated over
the bylaw changes.

  DIRECTOR ZUCKERMAN moved, seconded by DIRECTOR ZERUNYAN, TO
  APPROVE AS FOLLOWS BY THE FOLLOWING ROLL CALL VOTE:

  THAT THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD POSTPONE
  CONSIDERATION OF THE BYLAW AMENDMENTS TO ALLOW THE
  PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION ADVISORY BOARD TO SEPARATELY
  CONSIDER THE AMENDMENTS AND THEN RETURN TO THE CITY
  COUNCIL FOR CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

DIRECTOR MITCHELL summarized the intent of these suggested bylaw changes, which is to
expand the purpose of the Pepper Tree Foundation to allow for more opportunities and
flexibility within the Foundation, to be able to use the Foundation to its full potential.

B.  APPROVAL OF THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION INDEMNITY AGREEMENT

  DIRECTOR ZERUNYAN moved, seconded by DIRECTOR HUFF,

  THAT THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD APPROVE THE PEPPER
  TREE FOUNDATION INDEMNITY AGREEMENT.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

14.  ADJOURNMENT

DIRECTOR MITCHELL moved, seconded by, DIRECTOR ZERUNYAN,

  THAT THE PEPPER TREE FOUNDATION BOARD ADJOURN TO THE
  REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING.

  Hearing no objection, at 7:03 p.m. MAYOR SCHMITZ so ordered.

Submitted by,  Approved by,

Lauren Pettit  Velveth Schmitz
City Clerk  Mayor

CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
OCTOBER 13, 2020
